Dear colleagues, students, researchers,

We are pleased to announce a fully funded PhD position jointly supervised by Prof. E Dubois (University of Toulouse – France) and Prof. C Gouin-Vallerand (University of Sherbrooke – Canada): “Bridging Temporal and Physical Spaces: Combining Mixed Reality and Digital Twin for Situated Building Analytics and Decision Support”.

This doctoral research project aims to explore how Mixed Reality (MR) and Digital Twin technologies can be combined to support the in-situ visualization, analysis, and interpretation of building data. The project will investigate innovative ways of interacting to integrate physical environments and spatio-temporal digital information in order to enhance building monitoring, analytics, and decision-making processes. Particular attention will be given to human interaction with Digital Twins through immersive and situated visualization techniques.

This PhD is offered within the BEST (Between Earth and Sky in Toulouse) doctoral program, funded by the prestigious Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) COFUND scheme. The first BEST call will fund 19 PhD projects at the University of Toulouse, with doctoral contracts starting in September 2027. BEST supports interdisciplinary research addressing major societal transformations, including health and well-being, adaptation to global change, energy transition, industrial transformation and space technologies and exploration.

Who can apply? Academic Requirements: By the call deadline, candidates must hold a master’s degree or equivalent diploma; and must not hold a doctoral degree.

Mobility Rule: Applicants must not have resided or conducted their primary activity (work, studies, etc.) in France for more than 12 months in the 36 months preceding the call deadline. Periods of stay as a tourist, refugee, or time spent in national service are not considered as residency.
